exact_collision_free_prefix.coverage_method: For each even r, enumerate every simple labeled realization of degree sequence 3^r 2^(n-r) after normalizing the r degree-3 Cells to labels 0..r-1. Every isomorphism type admits such a labeling, so invariant-image and collision coverage is exact modulo relabeling.
exact_collision_free_prefix.family: U_BR(n): connected simple n-Cell graphs, every degree in {2,3}, at least one degree-3 Cell, modulo relabeling
exact_collision_free_prefix.image_freeze_contract: The deterministic checker canonically serializes every representable relation packet; each size image is frozen by its SHA256 and the union by combined_image_sha256. The exact image is mechanically reconstructible from the checker without sampling.
